import random
import string

def generate_test_case():
    length_haystack = random.randint(1, 10**3)
    length_needle = random.randint(1, 10**2)

    haystack = ''.join(random.choices(string.ascii_lowercase, k=length_haystack))
    needle = ''.join(random.choices(string.ascii_lowercase, k=length_needle))

    return haystack, needle
